obligations.title: A released product has a named owner
obligations.message: No owner is recorded. A released product needs someone answerable for it.

obligations.title: A released product states how its data is classified
obligations.message: No data classification is recorded. Consumers and access controls have no basis to decide how this data may be handled.

obligations.title: A released product states whether it is GxP relevant
obligations.message: GxP relevance is not recorded. Whether a product falls under GxP is a decision that must be made deliberately, not left unanswered.

obligations.title: A GxP-relevant product states its criticality
obligations.message: This product is GxP relevant but records no criticality, so the depth of validation it needs cannot be derived.
